_comment: Portable app manifest for scripts/install-portable.ps1, driven by scripts/setup.ps1. Every sha256 below is a real value measured from the official release asset. 'assoc' lists the file types this app should be offered for (used by the link phase; Windows still requires one manual click per type to set a DEFAULT - see SKILL.md).

apps.name: JPEGView
apps.notes: Image viewing. Starts instantly, handles huge folders. Launched with no argument it opens its own NavPanel.png - normal. Put strings_zh.txt in place for a Chinese UI. NOTE the exe path: the archive has THREE top-level folders (JPEGView32 / JPEGView32-WinXP / JPEGView64), so the single-top-level-directory collapse cannot flatten it and a bare 'JPEGView.exe' never matches - that silently produced no shortcut. Keep the relative path.

apps.name: MPC-BE
apps.notes: Video and audio with a normal player UI: playlist, Ctrl+Up/Down speed, Ctrl+L subtitles. Needs a 7-Zip that can read .7z (scoop has it; the reduced 7zr.exe is enough for this one but NOT for the .zip entries).

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.notes: Native text editor that replaces the Electron Markdown editor this manifest used to ship. Measured reason for the swap: an Electron editor is the slowest thing in the manifest to start, and on a 'starts fast, simple UI' requirement a native editor wins outright - MarkText / VNote / Yank Note / Zettlr were all tried on a real machine and all removed. Notepad++ gives Markdown syntax highlighting with zero plugins; for live preview use VSCode Ctrl+Shift+V instead of adding another app. This is the portable build: doLocalConf.xml ships inside the zip, so settings stay in the app folder instead of %APPDATA%.

apps.name: TrafficMonitor
apps.notes: Taskbar readout for CPU / memory / network speed - the desktop-side companion to an in-game overlay, and it needs no injection so it cannot upset anti-cheat. Low cost: one ~35 MB process polling once per second. TWO THINGS THAT BITE. (1) It stores settings in TrafficMonitor.ini next to the exe and decides the ENCODING by looking for a UTF-8 BOM: rewrite that file without a BOM and every Chinese label turns to mojibake. Always write it with an explicit UTF-8 BOM. (2) The taskbar window only appears when show_task_bar_wnd=true and hide_main_window=1; otherwise you get a floating window and an empty taskbar. The zip does NOT include global_cfg.ini, so a portable install needs one containing [config] / portable_mode = true next to the exe, or settings go to %APPDATA%. Windows 11 24H2+ ships no Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay, so do not assume Game Bar is available as a fallback.

apps.name: rclone
apps.notes: Command-line sync/backup to a NAS over SMB or WebDAV. `rclone mount` needs WinFsp (elevation) - map the drive with the OS instead.
